name: Dog House | Gratiot Gold Smalls
description: Sourdough is an indoor-grown strain that's ideal for patients seeking a high-THC indica. Known for its savoury aroma notes of sour, cake, and gas, Sourdough has a lineage from Cake and Diesel genetics and features large, forest-green buds flecked in purple hues with heavy trichome coverage.
